messages:
incident-bot: Pager: APIGateway5xxAlert fired in us-east-1 (sev2) — error-rate spike + timeouts observed on gateway->upstream. Auto-page to eng-oncall.

maria: I’m on call. Noted customer-facing errors in Sentry and we’re seeing 5xx from the NGINX edge. Increasing error rate across multiple routes.

aj: which upstreams are 5xxing? gateway to model-serving or to payment? I see increased 502/504 logs to model-proxy.

maria: model-proxy and metadata-service both have elevated 5xx. Latency to model-proxy is also spiking ~2-5s then 504.

derek: tagging network here — looks like a transient spike in outbound connection resets to our model cluster in us-east-1. Could be capacity or kernel-level conn issues.

alice: any customer impact? any big customers complaining?

maria: a few high-traffic customers reported timeouts for generation endpoints. Console shows degraded success rate, hitting SLAs for some routes.

sre-manager: Maria, take incident lead. AJ triage model-proxy, Derek check host/network, Alice prepare comms if needed. Keep notes for postmortem and alert tuning.

maria: on it. Live mitigation: enabling fallback-routing policy to route requests from high-latency hosts to dedicated pool. Applying now.

aj: checking model-proxy logs — stack traces show `socket_timeout` and `upstream reset`. I’m toggling connection pool size in the config to reduce churn.

derek: running `tcpdump` on a rotated host, seeing SYN/ACK drops around 14:12. Pinging infra team for any node reboots/maintenance.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: Rolling restart scheduled for autoscaler in us-east-1 at 14:18 by infra-team (commit a1b2c3). If this correlates, will cause transient failures.

maria: infra restart could explain it. AJ, abort any config changes if infra restart will resolve; otherwise keep adjustments.

aj: I’ll hold on risky changes. For now, I’m increasing upstream timeout to 12s & enabling retry=1 on the gateway for idempotent GET routes. Doing it via canary (10%).

alice: drafting quick status: "We’re investigating elevated 5xx/timeouts for some generation endpoints in us-east-1. Mitigations in progress; will update in 15m." Should I post to #customer-facing? Need approval.

sre-manager: post that. Mention impacted routes and that we're routing to dedicated pool where possible. No full outage yet.

maria: after routing change, success rate improved ~30% on the affected host group. Still seeing some 504s though.

derek: infra confirmed a rolling restart started unexpectedly early due to a cron bug. They paused it to evaluate. Rolling restarts can cause connection churn — we should avoid during peak.

aj: after canary retry enabled, error rate dropped further. I’m promoting to 50% traffic and monitoring.

maria: nice. Starting to see downstream metrics normalize. Customers on dedicated pools unaffected.

sre-manager: Good mitigation. Action items for post-incident: 1) add maintenance window check before rolling restarts 2) tune 5xx alert thresholds to avoid noisy paging 3) add dashboard for gateway->upstream ERR rates by restart events 4) improve routing fallback documentation.

alice: capturing that. Also suggest we add an automated suppressor: if infra restart tag is present, suppress pagers to on-call but notify infra channel — what do you think?

derek: careful — suppressing could hide real issues. Instead: route alerts to infra and SRE with reduced severity and a small on-call notification unless error-rate exceeds a higher bar.

maria: agree with Derek. For now, keeping manual escalation. We should adjust alerting after the postmortem.

aj: on alert tuning specifics: the APIGateway5xxAlert currently fires at 1% 5xx over 5m across all routes. That’s noisy during deploys. Proposal: change to 2% 5xx for 5m, or keep 1% but require growth relative to baseline (e.g., 2x baseline) and require cardinality across >1 upstream to page.

sre-manager: that sounds reasonable. Also add a synthetic check for model-proxy health (simple /healthcheck latency < 500ms) separate from aggregated 5xx to help signal true service degradation.

alice: I’ll open a backlog ticket for the dashboard & synthetic checks. Also PRs: alert threshold change + new runbook section for infra maintenance interactions.

maria: continuing to monitor. No new pages in last 10m. I’ll handoff in 30m to Derek who will stay through the rolling restart finish.

derek: ready for handoff. I’ll keep an eye for residual 5xx or new failures after infra completes.

ops-bot: incident-bot: Incident archived as 'mitigated' at 14:45, brief: routing fallback + retries reduced error rate. Followups required.

maria: final notes for retrospective: root cause = unexpected early rolling restart causing connection churn -> upstream resets -> increased 5xx/timeouts. Immediate mitigations: routing fallback, canary retries, abort restart. Long-term: alert tuning, maintenance gating, dashboard, synthetic health.

sre-manager: assign owners: Derek -> infra gating + playbook, AJ -> alert config PR (threshold/logic), Alice -> customer comms template & dashboard, Maria -> postmortem doc. Targeting follow-up RFC in 2 weeks.

alice: posted comms to #customer-facing and notified 3 affected customers directly. Will follow up with timeline once we have postmortem.

maria: handing off to Derek now. If anything spikes, escalate to sre-manager.

derek: ack. Leaving this thread open until infra confirms restart completion and 1h of stable metrics.

maria: thanks team :thumbsup:

-- end of thread --
